//: Shared compiler options. The three configs beside this one differ only in what they
cover and how they resolve modules: the collector is compiled for Node, the dashboard
is bundled by Vite, and metrics.ts and dataset.ts are checked by both because both
noUncheckedIndexedAccess is deliberately off. The dataset decoder is an unbroken run of
positional array reads, and turning every one of them into `T | undefined` would buy
assertions rather than safety: a dataset with an out-of-range dictionary index is
already refused by the version guard.
